content.json:
# Identity Sign-ins

Interactive sign-ins to Microsoft Entra ID. Use it to answer three questions quickly: is something
attacking our accounts (failures spread across many accounts from one address), did an attack work
(a success after the failures, a new country, a risky sign-in), and what are we leaving open
(legacy authentication, sign-ins without MFA).

"Interrupted" means Entra ID asked the user for something more (MFA, consent, a password change)
and is not counted as a failure.

**Tables read:** `SigninLogs`. A tile or chart for a table you do not collect shows an error; the rest still works.

content.query:
let Interrupts = dynamic(["50058", "50140", "51006", "50059", "65001", "52004", "50055", "50144", "50072", "50074",
                          "16000", "16001", "16003", "50127", "50125", "50129", "50143", "81010", "81014", "81012"]);
SigninLogs
| summarize SignIns = count(),
            Successful = countif(ResultType == "0"),
            Failed = countif(ResultType != "0" and ResultType !in (Interrupts)),
            Users = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
            Risky = countif(RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high", "medium")),
            Legacy = countif(ResultType == "0" and isnotempty(ClientAppUsed)
                             and ClientAppUsed !in ("Browser", "Mobile Apps and Desktop clients")),
            SingleFactor = countif(ResultType == "0" and AuthenticationRequirement == "singleFactorAuthentication")
| project Tiles = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metric", "Sign-ins", "Value", SignIns),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Successful", "Value", Successful),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Failed", "Value", Failed),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Users", "Value", Users),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Risky (medium or high)", "Value", Risky),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Successful with legacy authentication", "Value", Legacy),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Successful with a single factor", "Value", SingleFactor))
| mv-expand Tile = Tiles
| project Metric = tostring(Tile.Metric), Value = tolong(Tile.Value)
content.title: Sign-ins in the time range
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:

content.json:
Start with the second table. An address that fails for many accounts, a few times each, is a password
spray; if **Successful** is not zero for that address, those accounts need attention first.

content.query:
let Interrupts = dynamic(["50058", "50140", "51006", "50059", "65001", "52004", "50055", "50144", "50072", "50074",
                          "16000", "16001", "16003", "50127", "50125", "50129", "50143", "81010", "81014", "81012"]);
SigninLogs
| where ResultType != "0" and ResultType !in (Interrupts)
| summarize Failures = count(),
            Addresses = dcount(IPAddress),
            Countries = strcat_array(make_set(Location, 8), ", "),
            arg_max(TimeGenerated, ResultDescription)
            by Account = UserPrincipalName
| project Account, Failures, Addresses, Countries, LastFailure = TimeGenerated, LastError = ResultDescription
| top 50 by Failures desc
content.title: Accounts with the most failed sign-ins
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
SigninLogs
| summarize Accounts = dcountif(UserPrincipalName, ResultType in ("50126", "50053")),
            Failures = countif(ResultType in ("50126", "50053")),
            Successful = countif(ResultType == "0"),
            Country = take_any(Location),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Address = IPAddress
| where Accounts >= 5
| top 50 by Accounts desc
content.title: Addresses that fail for many accounts (password spray candidates)
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
SigninLogs
| where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high", "medium", "low")
| project TimeGenerated,
          Account = UserPrincipalName,
          Risk = case(RiskLevelDuringSignIn == "high", "High", RiskLevelDuringSignIn == "medium", "Medium", "Low"),
          State = RiskState,
          Detections = RiskEventTypes_V2,
          Address = IPAddress,
          Country = Location,
          Application = AppDisplayName,
          Result = iff(ResultType == "0", "Success", ResultDescription)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 250
content.title: Risky sign-ins
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == "0"
| where isnotempty(ClientAppUsed) and ClientAppUsed !in ("Browser", "Mobile Apps and Desktop clients")
| summarize SignIns = count(), Addresses = dcount(IPAddress), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Account = UserPrincipalName, Protocol = ClientAppUsed
| top 50 by SignIns desc
content.title: Successful sign-ins with legacy authentication

content.query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == "0" and isnotempty(Location)
| summarize CountryCount = dcount(Location),
            Countries = strcat_array(make_set(Location, 10), ", "),
            SignIns = count(),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Account = UserPrincipalName
| where CountryCount > 1
| top 50 by CountryCount desc
content.title: Accounts signing in successfully from more than one country

content.json: These are the detection rules in this repository for this area (`Detection-rules/` in SentinelWork). A rule with 0 alerts is either not deployed, not enabled, or has had nothing to report in the time range. Alerts are matched to rules by name, so a rule you rename in Sentinel stops being counted here. Incidents are matched by rule name or by the rule's identifier, so they survive a rename.

content.query:
let Rules = datatable(RuleId:string, AlertName:string, RuleSeverity:string, Tactics:string) [
    "ID-001", "Password spray from a single IP address", "Medium", "CredentialAccess",
    "ID-002", "Repeated MFA denials followed by a successful sign-in", "High", "CredentialAccess",
    "ID-003", "Successful sign-in from a country new for the user", "Medium", "InitialAccess",
    "ID-004", "Successful sign-in with legacy authentication", "Medium", "InitialAccess"
];
let AlertCounts = SecurityAlert
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AlertName) by SystemAlertId
    | summarize AlertCount = count(), LastAlert = max(TimeGenerated) by AlertName;
Rules
| join kind=leftouter AlertCounts on AlertName
| project RuleId, Rule = AlertName, Severity = RuleSeverity, Tactics, Alerts = coalesce(AlertCount, 0), LastAlert
| order by RuleId asc
content.title: Rule coverage
content.noDataMessage: No rules are defined for this area.

content.query:
let RuleNames = dynamic(["Password spray from a single IP address", "Repeated MFA denials followed by a successful sign-in", "Successful sign-in from a country new for the user", "Successful sign-in with legacy authentication"]);
SecurityAlert
| where AlertName in (RuleNames)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AlertName) by SystemAlertId
| summarize Alerts = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), AlertName
content.title: Alerts over time, by rule
content.noDataMessage: None of these rules raised an alert in the time range.

content.query:
let RuleNames = dynamic(["Password spray from a single IP address", "Repeated MFA denials followed by a successful sign-in", "Successful sign-in from a country new for the user", "Successful sign-in with legacy authentication"]);
SecurityAlert
| where AlertName in (RuleNames)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| project TimeGenerated, Rule = AlertName, Severity = AlertSeverity, Status,
          Details = tostring(parse_json(ExtendedProperties)["Custom Details"]), Entities
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 250
content.title: Latest alerts

content.query:
let RuleNames = dynamic(["Password spray from a single IP address", "Repeated MFA denials followed by a successful sign-in", "Successful sign-in from a country new for the user", "Successful sign-in with legacy authentication"]);
let RuleIds = dynamic(["07dec7c4-739b-532d-af40-42fb21e26b80", "831b9d58-0963-5eab-a47d-eeeb3abc5e70", "87b9d102-9b9f-525f-9cb8-86c89524b112", "583e2ac9-9a18-54af-ae9b-78731592650e"]);
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Title in (RuleNames) or tostring(RelatedAnalyticRuleIds) has_any (RuleIds)
| extend LabelText = tostring(Labels)
| project CreatedTime, IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, Classification,
          AssignedTo = tostring(Owner.assignedTo),
          AgentDisposition = extract(@"soc-agent:(page|queue|auto_close|pending)", 1, LabelText), IncidentUrl
| order by CreatedTime desc
| take 250
content.title: Incidents created by these rules
content.noDataMessage: No incidents from these rules in the time range.
